summary: A supported seated selectorized chest press, following the ACE version.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Adjust the seat for handles at mid-chest, no deeper than the front of the chest. Support the back and plant the feet.
Take a closed grip with wrists aligned to forearms; brace the abdomen and keep shoulder blades against the backrest.
executionSteps: Press slowly while exhaling, keeping wrists aligned and avoiding an increased low-back arch.
Extend elbows without locking, pause briefly, then return slowly. Keep the shoulder blades supported.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position under control.
keyCheckpoints: Keep the shoulder blades against the backrest.
technique.breathing: Exhale gently during the press; the guide does not specify return-phase breathing.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the shoulder blades away from the backrest during this supported version.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this source version; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Keep the shoulder blades against the backrest.

summary: The ACE prone selectorized curl version; pad placement and endpoints depend on this machine guide.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Lie prone with the knee joint aligned to the machine pivot. Place pads against the lower third of the lower legs, away from the heel.
Hold available handles, brace the abdomen and keep the low back steady.
executionSteps: Exhale while bending knees and drawing pads toward the buttocks without arching the back.
The guide offers endpoints of knees bent beyond a right angle, lower legs vertical, or pads near the buttocks. Pause briefly and return under control.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position under control.
keyCheckpoints: Keep the low back steady; reduce resistance if that position cannot be controlled.
technique.breathing: Exhale slowly during knee flexion; the guide does not specify return-phase breathing.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the low back during the curl.
mistakes.whyItMatters: Technique differs from this source version; no injury probability is inferred.
mistakes.correction: Keep the low back steady; reduce resistance if that position cannot be controlled.

summary: A supine stability-ball curl described in the same ACE laboratory report.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Anatomy-based relationship to the source-described joint movement; not measured activation, isolation or a primary/secondary ranking.

setup: Lie supine with heels on a stability ball and arms spread for support. Raise hips into line with shoulders.
executionSteps: Bend knees to roll the ball toward the hips until soles rest on it, maintaining hip alignment.
Roll the ball away slowly to extend the knees.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the source-described starting position under control.
keyCheckpoints: Maintain hips in line with the shoulders.
